verse.verse_1: Blest be He in whose hand is the dominion, and He is over everything Potent.
verse.verse_2: Who hath created death and life that He might prove you, as to which of you is excellent in work. And He is the Mighty, the Forgiver.
verse.verse_3: Who hath created seven heavens in storeys. Thou shalt not behold in the Compassionates creation any over-sight; then repeat thy look, beholdest thou any crack?
verse.verse_4: Then repeat thy look twice over, and thy look will return Unto thee dim and It will have become wearied out.
verse.verse_5: And assuredly We have bedecked the nearest heaven with lamps, and We have made them missiles for satans: and for them We have gotten ready the torment of the Blaze.
verse.verse_6: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord will be the torment of Hell; and a hapless destination!
verse.verse_7: When they will be cast thereinto, they will hear thereof a braying even as it balleth up,
verse.verse_8: Well-nigh it bursteth with rage. So oft as a company is cast thereinto, the keepers thereof will ask them: came there not Unto you a warner?
verse.verse_9: They will say: yea! surely there came a warner Unto us, but we belied, and said: God hath not sent down aught, are naught but in a great error.
verse.verse_10: And they will say: had we been wont to hearken or to reflect, we had not been among the fellows of the Blaze.
verse.verse_11: So they shall confess their sin. Far away they-be, the fellows of the Blaze!
verse.verse_12: Verily those who dread their Lord unseen, theirs shall be forgiveness and a great hire.
verse.verse_13: And whather ye keep your discourse secret or publish it, verily He is the Knower of that which is in the breasts.
verse.verse_14: Shall not He Who hath created know? And He is the Subtile, the Aware.
verse.verse_15: He it is Who hath made the earth Unto you subservient, so go forth in the regions thereof, and eat of His provision. And Unto Him is the Resurrection.
verse.verse_16: Are ye secure that He who is in the heaven will not sink the earth with you and then it should quake?
verse.verse_17: Or are ye secure that He Who is in the heaven will not send against you a whirlwind? Anon ye shall know what wise hath been My warning.
verse.verse_18: And assuredly those before them belied; then what wise hath been My wrath!
verse.verse_19: Behold they not the birds above them, outstretching their wings and they also withdraw them? Naught holdeth them except the Compassionate. Verily He is of everything Beholder.
verse.verse_20: Who. is he that can be an army Unto you and succour you, beside the Compassionate! The infidelsjb are but in delusion.
verse.verse_21: Who is he that can provide for you, should He withhold His provision? Aye! they persists in perverseness and aversion.
verse.verse_22: Is he, then, who goeth about grovelling upon his face better directed, or he who walketh evenly on a straight path?
verse.verse_23: Say thou: He it is who hath brought you forth and hath endowed you with hearing and sights and hearts. Little thanks it is ye give!
verse.verse_24: Say thou: He it is Who hath spread you over the earth, and Unto Him ye shall be gathered.
verse.verse_25: And they say: when will this promise be fulfilled, if ye say sooth?
verse.verse_26: Say thou: the knowledge is only with Allah, and but a warner manifest.
verse.verse_27: But when they will behold it proximating sad will be the countenances of those who disbelieve, and it will be said: this is that which ye have been calling for.
verse.verse_28: Say thou: bethink ye if Allah destroy me and those with me; or have mercy on us, who will protect the infidels from a torment afflictive?
verse.verse_29: Say thou: He is the Compassionate; in Him we have believed, and in Him we have put our trust. -And anon ye will know who it is that is in error manifest.
verse.verse_30: Say thou: bethink ye, were your water to be sunk away, who then could bring you water welling-up?
